unresolved_added: The split from X0 into Y0 and Z0 is described by purpose but the exact construction of the growth component is not independently defined before fitting.
GM(1,1) is fitted to only fifteen annual counts without posterior-error, small-error probability, residual, or sensitivity diagnostics.
The printed B matrix is difficult to reconcile from the text layer and no numerical matrix or replayable calculation is supplied.
The residual sequence is passed to an AR(2) model without publishing coefficients, innovations, stationarity checks, confidence intervals, or forecast errors.
The AR order is chosen from visually described ACF/PACF censoring and tailing, but no numerical correlogram values or information-criterion comparison is reported.
Rounded GM and AR component forecasts are recombined without propagating parameter or residual uncertainty.
The reported correlation coefficient 0.9767 uses the same 1985-1999 interval that produced the model rather than an independent holdout.
The obvious post-2000 deviation shows a structural break; the baseline forecast cannot be treated as a stable future law.
The recovery-program explanation is temporally plausible but is not isolated from survey effort, population decline, reporting changes, habitat conditions, or other confounding factors.
Forecasting entanglement counts is converted into a claim that the Hawaiian monk seal will vanish without a population-dynamics or demographic model.
Food-chain destruction and ecosystem disorder are asserted as long-term consequences without a food-web model, alternative pathways, or quantitative evidence.
Direct debris, population, and economy indicators may overlap or double count generation pressure, but their causal and measurement relationships are not specified.
The displayed AHP comparison matrix is not reciprocal in its plastics-textiles pair, while no consistency ratio or matrix correction is reported.
AHP weights are stated after a summation method without judgment provenance, consistency testing, uncertainty, or sensitivity.
Printed Equation (3) uses PD in Indirect Data although the symbol table defines POD for population; this appears to be a consequential symbol error.
Ocean Ecosystem Impacts and Coastal Economy Impacts receive equal weights without a displayed comparison matrix or evidence for the trade-off.
Global min-max adjustment depends on the chosen table and time span, can change historical ranks when new years are added, and has no out-of-range rule.
The vector preserves two metrics initially, but the squared Euclidean comparison function silently imposes equal scaling and substitutability after normalization.
Calling lower vector length a better ocean system is a normative criterion, not an empirically validated welfare or ecosystem objective.
USA discarded-debris statistics are used as a proxy for debris entering the ocean without leakage rates, transport, geography, or international sources.
Hawaiian monk-seal entanglements are used as the ocean-ecosystem impact component for annual ocean-system evaluation, which is a narrow and changing proxy.
Figures 11-13 have no released underlying table, code, uncertainty band, or audit trail; labels also contain typographic truncation.
The paper concludes the system is becoming worse even though it says the increasing trend based on actual impacts is not obvious.
The feedback diagram contains no dynamic recovery equation, gain, delay, saturation, measurement rule, stability analysis, or controller design.
The Strength section calls the combined prediction good despite the acknowledged post-2000 regime failure and absence of an external forecast test.
AHP subjectivity is acknowledged, but no sensitivity, robustness, or alternative weighting analysis is performed.
Cleanup, incentives, education, funding, recycling, and legislation are proposed without costs, jurisdiction, compliance, equity, non-target effects, or measured effectiveness.
Only six references are supplied and several background, data, and causal claims cannot be independently reconstructed from frozen source files.
